name: Alternian Turnabout: Aradia Megido
source:
Taking place before the revenge cycle or SGRUB began, a murder that occurs during a night of FLARPing pits Team Charge and Team Scourge against each other in a competitive attempt to achieve a desired verdict.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=31687]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在复仇周期或SGRUB开始之前，在FLARPing之夜发生的谋杀案让冲锋队和天灾队相互竞争，试图达成预期的判决。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=31687]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
